title: Become a member
intro: Anyone aged 18 or over who supports the association's purpose may join the {orgName} (§ 4 of the Satzung). Legal entities may be admitted on application.

process.heading: How it works
steps: Submit an application in text form (letter or email) to the board, with the details needed for membership administration (§ 2 of the Geschäftsordnung).
The board decides, usually within six weeks. There is no right to admission, and a refusal does not need to be justified.
On admission, you accept the Satzung and the Geschäftsordnung.

fees.heading: Fees
fees.intro: Fees are collected monthly and are due at the start of the month. The following monthly rates apply:
items: Standard fee: €10 — all members without a reduction
Reduced fee: €5 — pupils, students, recipients of Bürgergeld, and hardship cases
Fee waived: €0 — members with a disability rating (GdB) of at least 50, honorary members, and special hardship cases
fees.note: These rates are set out in the Beitragsordnung per Beschluss (board resolution) No. 2026-0003 of 19 July 2026, in effect since 1 October 2026.

volunteer.heading: Volunteer hours
volunteer.text: Each member contributes 12 hours of volunteer work per financial year, starting with the first full year after admission. Unworked hours may instead be settled with a payment of €5 per hour (§ 4 of the Geschäftsordnung).
volunteer.exemptions: Exemptions include members with a disability rating (GdB) of at least 50, members unable to volunteer due to illness, age or distance, documented hardship cases, and honorary members.
